csv.noTasksHint: Create a PERFORMANCE campaign to upload conversion data here
csv.pasteOrChoose: Paste CSV or select a file
csv.detailNote1: Use the user's email or account ID from your platform—data is irreversibly processed upon receipt, never stored in plain text (see Data Processing Commitment below). Always use the same identifier for the same user.
csv.detailNote2: Incremental or full uploads both work—deduplication is by code+user, so re-uploads or overlaps never result in double billing.
csv.detailNote3: Ensure each user can only use one referral code in your system—if a user converts via multiple codes they will each be billed separately (every ambassador deserves credit). Such duplicate costs are borne by the merchant.
csv.detailNote4: The 'Converted' column accepts 1/0. Changing 1 to 0 does not reverse settled payouts.
csv.detailNote5: There is a 30-day grace period after a campaign closes. Upload all remaining conversions before the deadline.
csv.aggregateNote1: Enter cumulative totals (as of today), not daily increments.
csv.aggregateNote2: Only new conversions are settled. Re-uploading the same data will not double-charge.
csv.aggregateNote3: Settled amounts are non-refundable. Entering lower numbers won't trigger refunds.
csv.aggregateNote4: Referral codes must belong to the selected campaign. Wrong campaigns are flagged explicitly.
csv.aggregateNote5: There is a 30-day grace period after a campaign closes. Upload all remaining conversions before the deadline.
csv.privacy1: Per the Service Agreement's data processing terms, the platform does not store plaintext email/user IDs: data is immediately SHA-256 salted and hashed upon receipt, the original is discarded and never appears in any database or log.
csv.privacy2: Hashes are used solely for referral attribution deduplication and settlement reconciliation—no other purpose, never cross-referenced with other merchants.
csv.privacy3: All displays (including internal admin views) show only masked forms (e.g. a**@gmail.com). The one-way hash cannot be reversed.
csv.privacy4: After a campaign ends you may contact support to delete all detail records (settlement receipts are retained per financial requirements).
csv.errMinRows: Data must have at least 2 rows (header + data)
csv.errNoUserCol: This campaign is in Detail Mode. Header must include a user column (e.g. User Email or ID)—download the template.
csv.errNoAggCols: This campaign is in Aggregate Mode. Header must include 'Registrations' and 'Conversions' columns—download the template.
csv.errNoValidRows: No valid data rows found. Check the CSV format.
csv.errNoProcessed: No records were processed. Check the data format.

onboard.title: Brand Registration
onboard.isAgencyDesc: I manage campaigns for multiple brands
onboard.agreeContent:
Welcome to Herix Brand Merchant Services. This agreement applies to brands and advertising agencies (collectively "Merchants") that publish campaigns, recruit Ambassadors, and complete content collaborations on the Herix platform.

1. Services
Herix provides Merchants with Ambassador recruitment, campaign publishing, content review, and performance tracking services. Platform service fees apply per campaign settlement terms.

2. Merchant Responsibilities
Merchants must ensure all published campaign content is lawful and compliant. Merchants may not post false advertising, prohibited products, or infringing content. Merchants bear full responsibility for the accuracy of brand materials and product information provided.

3. Data Processing
Merchants agree that Herix may collect, store, and process necessary business data pursuant to the Data Processing Addendum for service operations and performance reporting, in compliance with applicable privacy regulations.

4. Settlement & Payment
Settlement is based on campaign completion. Applicable rates and payment cycles are governed by the agreement version displayed in the Merchant dashboard. Merchants must complete top-ups and reconciliation within the stipulated timeframe.

5. Agreement Updates
Herix reserves the right to amend this agreement with 15 days' prior notice to Merchants. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the revised terms.
onboard.agreeText: I have read and agree to the Herix Merchant Service Agreement and Data Processing Addendum
onboard.agreeHint: Clicking 'Complete Registration' constitutes acceptance of the above agreements
